title: request for quotations - u.s. embassy in bolivia
paragraphs: the american embassy bolivia invites you to submit a tender offer for services and supplies based on the below scope of work. you are encouraged to submit an offer and all prices must be submitted on a firm fixed price basis. the solicitations do not commit the american embassy bolivia to make any award. the embassy may cancel the solicitation or any part of it.
